title: Table Four
summary: A turn-based board game played from the seats: four in a row, and nobody is a character, so each friend is a seat card with an avatar that reacts, a pointer and every disc they drop.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 22/22; measure 5's presence leg: seats on both screens, 2 of 2 moves each way landed on the other screen within 3 s, each pointer seen
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from table-four, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 183 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl")
